name: Loyalty Points
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Viewers earn your own channel currency by chatting, then share it, gamble it or climb the leaderboard.

settings.label: Currency name
settings.description: What your points are called, like "bones" or "coins".

settings.label: Points per chat message
settings.description: Set to 0 to stop earning from chat.

settings.label: Seconds between chat rewards
settings.description: A viewer earns at most once in this time, so spamming doesn't pay.

settings.label: Subscriber bonus
settings.description: Subscribers earn this many times the normal amount.

settings.label: Allow gambling
settings.description: Let viewers bet their points on a coin flip.

settings.label: Seconds between gambles
settings.description: How long a viewer waits between bets.

actions.name: Award chat points and answer points commands
actions.description: Awards points for chatting and answers points commands. Runs by itself, so you never need to add it.

fields.description: Points this message earned. 0 while the viewer is waiting.
The points command used, such as "gamble". Empty when none.

actions.name: Give points to a viewer
actions.description: Gives a viewer points, or takes them away with a negative number. Points never go below 0.

schema.label: Points
schema.description: A negative number takes points away.

schema.label: Reason
schema.description: Passed along when points change, for triggers that react to it.

fields.description: How much it really changed by. Less than asked if points ran out.

actions.name: Get a viewer's points
actions.description: Looks up how many points a viewer has.

fields.description: Their points. 0 if they have none.

triggers.name: Points changed
triggers.description: A viewer's points go up or down: chatting, gambling, giving or a mod change.

fields.description: How much it changed by. Negative for a loss.
What changed it: chat, gamble, give, gift from <name>, refund, carried over, added by mod, removed by mod, or a workflow's reason.
